mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for three consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise for 2 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100 during late-cycle expansion signals manufacturing contraction that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 during late-cycle expansion but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% year-over-year indicates persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% for 2 months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls declining below 100,000 year-over-year signals labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 100000 for 2 months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts combined with falling federal funds rate signals coordinated housing stimulus and monetary easing that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises and FEDFUNDS falls simultaneously but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% year-over-year indicates robust economic expansion that increases corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 2.5% for 2 quarters but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of cases.
